2607.11212.title: PREF-Gate: Provenance-Constrained Relational Evidence Fusion with Validation-Gated Selection for Graph Fraud Detection
2607.11212.paper_summary: Relational fraud detection can exploit both label-free graph context and label-derived neighborhood evidence, but these two information sources obey different validity conditions. In particular, neighborhood risk becomes invalid when a queried node's own label, or any validation or test label, enters its construction. We formulate this issue as provenance-constrained relational evidence use and present PREF-Gate, an auditable decision framework with two fixed experts and a finite validation gate. The context expert uses attributes, one-hop means, feature residuals, and degree descriptors without labels. The evidence expert adds self-excluded, training-label-only neighborhood risk and empirical-Bayes summaries that expose support, uncertainty, availability, and shrinkage. Before test inference, the gate selects either expert or one of three pre-specified probability mixtures and fixes the decision threshold. On Amazon, YelpChi, and TFinance, using five identical stratified splits and 14 same-protocol methods, PREF-Gate obtains mean AUPRC values of 0.9085, 0.8104, and 0.8913. It selects the label-free expert on all Amazon and YelpChi splits and an evidence mixture on all TFinance splits. Thus, the main result is conditional rather than universal: label-derived relational evidence is useful only where held-out validation supports it. The framework couples competitive ranking performance with an explicit label-provenance contract, finite selection policy, failure accounting, and review-budget evaluation, providing an auditable knowledge-based decision pipeline for graph fraud detection.
2607.11212.paper_summary_zh: 關聯性詐騙檢測可以利用無標籤的圖形上下文和標籤衍生的鄰域證據，但這兩種信息來源遵循不同的有效性條件。<lb/>特別是，當查詢節點的自身標籤或任何驗證或測試標籤進入其構建時，鄰域風險變得無效。<lb/>我們將此問題表述為來源約束的關聯證據使用，並提出PREF-Gate，一個具有兩個固定專家和有限驗證閘的可審計決策框架。<lb/>上下文專家使用屬性、一跳均值、特徵殘差和無標籤的度描述符。<lb/>證據專家添加自我排除的僅訓練標籤鄰域風險和揭示支持、不確定性、可用性和收縮的經驗貝葉斯摘要。<lb/>在測試推斷之前，閘門選擇任一專家或三個預先指定的概率混合之一並固定決策閾值。<lb/>在Amazon、YelpChi和TFinance上，使用五個相同的分層拆分和14種相同協議的方法，PREF-Gate獲得平均AUPRC值為0.9085、0.8104和0.8913。<lb/>它在所有Amazon和YelpChi拆分中選擇無標籤專家，而在所有TFinance拆分中選擇證據混合。<lb/>因此，主要結果是有條件的而非普遍的：標籤衍生的關聯證據僅在保留的驗證支持它的情況下才有用。<lb/>該框架將競爭排名性能與明確的標籤來源合約、有限選擇政策、失敗會計和審查預算評估結合起來，提供了一個可審計的基於知識的決策管道，用於圖形詐騙檢測。
